rationale.conceptual: The paper presents its own custom method (FD-CPIM) with frequency-dependent capacitances/polarizabilities, double Lorentzian oscillators, size-dependent correction, Gaussian-damped interaction tensors, and a (4N+1) relay matrix formulation. Implementing this from the equations requires genuine understanding of the physics and careful numerical translation; it's not a standard library call.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two sequential steps (generate spectra, then extract peaks) using standard Python libraries. No complex tooling, data fetching, or multi‑stage orchestration; I/O is simple CSV.
